snippet.title: Arthur’s Tale – Official Teaser | Can You Beat This?
snippet.description:
Arthur’s Tale – Official Teaser | Can You Beat This?
 Arthur's Tale is a high-octane action platformer designed to test your reflexes, precision, and patience!

Step into the boots of Arthur, a legendary adventurer on his final journey. Navigate through perilous jungles, ancient temples, and treacherous platforms levitating over the abyss. Every jump matters. Every mistake could be your last.

 What’s inside the Teaser:

Epic Boss Fights: Face off against colossal mechanical sentinels and ancient guardians.

Precision Gameplay: Master the art of the jump. Climb, swing, and fight with absolute accuracy.

Try Again: Failure is just a lesson. Are you ready to push your limits and go again?

 Key Information:

Wishlist on Steam: Add Arthur’s Tale to your wishlist and support the indie studio Cleaver Games!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4700460/Arthurs_Tale/

DEMO Coming June 1st, 2026: Get a first taste of the challenge.

Full Release: October 14, 2026.

Do you have what it takes to survive the ruins and uncover the truth behind Arthur's final tale?


#ArthursTale #IndieGame #Platformer #UnrealEngine5 #CleaverGames #Gaming #PCGaming #Steam #PS5 #ActionGame
